evidence_kind: numerical stage gates (realtime model versus offline truth model); not hardware tolerances
rationale: Pre-registered before any of the ws3 realtime models were evaluated. Each gate compares the realtime implementation with an offline double-precision truth model built from the same declared circuit equations (src/reference/*). Passing a gate shows the realtime model reproduces its declared model; it does not show agreement with an original CS-80. The same values are compiled into tests/Ws3Tolerances.h.

2.1_free_running.truth_model: src/reference/FreeRunningVoiceTruth.h: double-precision per-sample evolution of oscillator phase and both IG00156 circuit stages at the full internal rate, every sample, while the VCA is closed
2.1_free_running.idle_incremental_rtf_note: 48 kHz / 128-frame isolation idle_quiet row of cs80_source_factory_benchmark, compared with the 6719ce4 baseline on the same machine in the same session; the shared build machine makes this a diagnostic, not a qualification

2.2_kas_sample_hold.truth_model: src/reference/SampleHoldTruth.h: analytic constant-current droop of the held K node and the TC4011/TC4016 NAND(TR,SUS) truth table
2.2_kas_sample_hold.scan_latency_bound: detection latency in [0, scan period] for every event; exact ordering by declared scan order within one scan

2.3_keyboard_contour.truth_model: src/reference/KeyboardContour.h evaluated in double for every key/lever/trim combination

2.4_touch.truth_model: src/reference/TouchCircuitTruth.h: double-precision implicit (backward-Euler, 64x substepped) solution of the declared TWS b acquisition/hold, C high-pass with ideal clamp, TWS a smoothing and the TRG5 diode-OR bus solved by Newton iteration
